# agent-tools

> A structured autonomous agent execution system for GitHub Copilot and coding agents. Provides a plan-first, milestone-based execution framework with enforced code practices, safety governance, and on-demand specialist skills.

This toolkit is designed to be copied into any repository's `.github/` folder. Once in place, agents follow a deterministic boot sequence that enforces planning before execution, safety checks, playbook-driven implementation, and skill loading.

## System Instructions

- [AGENTS.md](.github/AGENTS.md): Primary entry point for autonomous agents — boot sequence, directory map, core rules
- [copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md): GitHub Copilot bootstrap — same boot sequence, skills and playbooks reference

## Planning Framework

- [agent-planning-framework.md](.github/instructions/agent-planning-framework.md): Core planning rules, plan file location, authority rules
- [agent-execution-protocol.md](.github/instructions/agent-execution-protocol.md): Milestone execution loop, failure recovery, resume protocol
- [agent-plan-generation.md](.github/instructions/agent-plan-generation.md): Pipeline for generating valid plans with playbooks pre-applied
- [agent-playbook-selection.md](.github/instructions/agent-playbook-selection.md): Auto-detection rules for which playbooks apply to a task
- [taskplan_TEMPLATE.md](.github/plan/taskplan_TEMPLATE.md): Template for all plan files

## Code & Safety Standards

- [agent-code-practices-framework.md](.github/instructions/agent-code-practices-framework.md): Mandatory coding standards enforced across all agent-generated code
- [agent-safety.instructions.md](.github/instructions/agent-safety.instructions.md): Safety and governance rules for AI agent systems
- [agent-skills.instructions.md](.github/instructions/agent-skills.instructions.md): Guidelines for creating and structuring SKILL.md files

## Language Instructions

- [python.instructions.md](.github/instructions/python.instructions.md): Idiomatic Python standards (PEP 8, type hints, error handling, testing)
- [typescript.instructions.md](.github/instructions/typescript.instructions.md): Idiomatic TypeScript/JavaScript standards (strict mode, naming, async, React)
- [go.instructions.md](.github/instructions/go.instructions.md): Idiomatic Go standards (Effective Go, naming, error handling, formatting)
- [csharp.instructions.md](.github/instructions/csharp.instructions.md): Idiomatic C# standards (Unity/Godot, nullable refs, memory, async, NUnit)
- [cpp.instructions.md](.github/instructions/cpp.instructions.md): Modern C++ standards (C++17/20, Unreal Engine, RAII, GC rules, clang-format)
- [swift.instructions.md](.github/instructions/swift.instructions.md): Idiomatic Swift standards (SwiftUI, async/await, ARC, adaptive layouts, XCTest)
- [kotlin.instructions.md](.github/instructions/kotlin.instructions.md): Idiomatic Kotlin/Android standards (Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, WindowSizeClass)
- [context-engineering.instructions.md](.github/instructions/context-engineering.instructions.md): Structuring code for better Copilot context and suggestions
- [ai-prompt-engineering-safety-best-practices.instructions.md](.github/instructions/ai-prompt-engineering-safety-best-practices.instructions.md): Prompt safety, bias mitigation, and responsible AI usage
- [game-design.instructions.md](.github/instructions/game-design.instructions.md): High-level game design principles — player experience, mechanics, game feel, difficulty, code patterns for game systems

## Playbooks

- [api-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/api-development.playbook.md): RESTful API implementation — contract-first, validation, error handling
- [testing.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/testing.playbook.md): Test pyramid, AAA structure, coverage minimums, isolation rules
- [debugging.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/debugging.playbook.md): Systematic defect isolation and fix verification
- [refactoring.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/refactoring.playbook.md): Behaviour-preserving code improvement
- [accessibility-compliance.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/accessibility-compliance.playbook.md): UI/UX accessibility and compliance implementation
- [performance.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/performance.playbook.md): Measure-first performance optimization workflow
- [game-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-development.playbook.md): Core loop first, vertical slice, playtest loop, scope management
- [game-testing.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-testing.playbook.md): Automated game logic tests, structured playtest sessions, platform certification
- [mobile-development.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/mobile-development.playbook.md): Design for smallest screen first, adaptive layout rules, App Store / Play Store submission checklist
- [monorepo-workflow.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/monorepo-workflow.playbook.md): Single-repo structure for web + mobile + backend — pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, affected-only CI, coordinated releases
- [narrative-design.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/narrative-design.playbook.md): Game narrative design workflow — narrative pillars, world bible, quest scripts, branching dialogue, playtest checklist
- [game-level-design.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-level-design.playbook.md): Level design workflow — paper map → greybox → encounter layout → pacing → environment dressing
- [game-balancing.playbook.md](.github/playbooks/game-balancing.playbook.md): Game balance workflow — balance spreadsheet, target metrics, playtest data, outlier detection, economy balance, difficulty curve

## Scripts

- [generate-plan.ts](.github/scripts/generate-plan.ts): Scaffolds a new plan file from the template. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/generate-plan.ts "<task name>"`
- [plan-validate.ts](.github/scripts/plan-validate.ts): Validates a plan file has all required sections and no unfilled placeholders. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-validate.ts .github/plan/<task>.plan.md`
- [plan-checksum.ts](.github/scripts/plan-checksum.ts): Computes a SHA-256 hash of milestone statuses for drift detection. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-checksum.ts .github/plan/<task>.plan.md`
- [plan-sync.ts](.github/scripts/plan-sync.ts): Verifies every skill, playbook, and instruction is referenced in AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md. Run: `npx ts-node .github/scripts/plan-sync.ts`

## Skills

On-demand specialist capabilities. Each skill's `SKILL.md` defines when it should be loaded.

### Agent & AI Safety

- [agent-governance](.github/skills/agent-governance/SKILL.md): Add governance, safety, and trust controls to AI agent systems — policy files, tool allowlists, audit trails, rate limits
- [agent-owasp-compliance](.github/skills/agent-owasp-compliance/SKILL.md): Check agent codebases against the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) Top 10
- [agent-supply-chain](.github/skills/agent-supply-chain/SKILL.md): Verify supply chain integrity for AI agent plugins — SHA-256 manifests, tamper detection, plugin provenance
- [agentic-eval](.github/skills/agentic-eval/SKILL.md): Evaluate and improve AI agent outputs — self-critique loops, rubric-based scoring, evaluator-optimizer pipelines
- [ai-prompt-engineering-safety-review](.github/skills/ai-prompt-engineering-safety-review/SKILL.md): Analyse prompts for safety, bias, security vulnerabilities, and effectiveness

### Azure

- [azure-architecture-autopilot](.github/skills/azure-architecture-autopilot/SKILL.md): Design or analyze Azure infrastructure — architecture diagrams, multi-region topologies, Bicep generation
- [azure-deployment-preflight](.github/skills/azure-deployment-preflight/SKILL.md): Pre-deployment validation — Bicep/Terraform syntax, what-if analysis, RBAC permission checks
- [azure-devops-cli](.github/skills/azure-devops-cli/SKILL.md): Manage Azure DevOps resources via CLI — projects, repos, pipelines, PRs, work items, artifacts
- [az-cost-optimize](.github/skills/az-cost-optimize/SKILL.md): Identify and recommend Azure cost savings across a subscription

### Codebase Knowledge

- [acquire-codebase-knowledge](.github/skills/acquire-codebase-knowledge/SKILL.md): Map, document, and onboard into an existing codebase — architecture diagrams, module inventory, dependency graph

### Documentation & Specifications

- [create-readme](.github/skills/create-readme/SKILL.md): Generate a comprehensive README.md
- [create-specification](.github/skills/create-specification/SKILL.md): Create a specification file optimized for AI consumption
- [create-llms](.github/skills/create-llms/SKILL.md): Generate an llms.txt file for a repository following the llms.txt specification
- [documentation-writer](.github/skills/documentation-writer/SKILL.md): Diataxis-based technical documentation expert — tutorials, how-tos, reference, explanation

### GDPR & Compliance

- [gdpr-compliant](.github/skills/gdpr-compliant/SKILL.md): Apply GDPR-compliant engineering practices — data minimisation, consent, encryption, retention/deletion, breach response
- [secret-scanning](.github/skills/secret-scanning/SKILL.md): Configure GitHub secret scanning, push protection, custom patterns, and secret alert remediation
- [security-review](.github/skills/security-review/SKILL.md): AI-powered codebase security scanner — injection, auth/access control, secrets exposure, weak crypto, insecure dependencies

### Go & MCP

- [go-mcp-server-generator](.github/skills/go-mcp-server-generator/SKILL.md): Generate a complete Go MCP server project using the official `github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk`
- [mcp-cli](.github/skills/mcp-cli/SKILL.md): Interface with MCP servers via CLI — list available tools, call MCP tools from command line
- [mcp-copilot-studio-server-generator](.github/skills/mcp-copilot-studio-server-generator/SKILL.md): Generate an MCP server optimised for Copilot Studio — schema constraints, streamable HTTP
- [mcp-create-adaptive-cards](.github/skills/mcp-create-adaptive-cards/SKILL.md): Create Adaptive Cards for use in MCP-connected agents and bots
- [mcp-create-declarative-agent](.github/skills/mcp-create-declarative-agent/SKILL.md): Create declarative agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot
- [mcp-deploy-manage-agents](.github/skills/mcp-deploy-manage-agents/SKILL.md): Deploy and manage agents in Microsoft Foundry via MCP
- [mcp-security-audit](.github/skills/mcp-security-audit/SKILL.md): Audit MCP server configurations — hardcoded secrets, shell injection, unpinned versions, approved server lists

### GTM

- [gtm-0-to-1-launch](.github/skills/gtm-0-to-1-launch/SKILL.md): Launch new products from idea to first customers — early adopters, launch week playbook, 2-week experiment cycle
- [gtm-ai-gtm](.github/skills/gtm-ai-gtm/SKILL.md): Go-to-market strategy for AI products — positioning, pricing variable-cost AI, copilot/agent/teammate framing
- [gtm-board-and-investor-communication](.github/skills/gtm-board-and-investor-communication/SKILL.md): Board meeting preparation, investor updates, QBRs — Three Things narrative, 4-tier metric hierarchy
- [gtm-developer-ecosystem](.github/skills/gtm-developer-ecosystem/SKILL.md): Build and scale developer-led adoption — open vs curated ecosystems, developer programs, student pipelines
- [gtm-enterprise-account-planning](.github/skills/gtm-enterprise-account-planning/SKILL.md): Strategic account planning for enterprise deals — MEDDICC qualification, stakeholder mapping, mutual action plans
- [gtm-enterprise-onboarding](.github/skills/gtm-enterprise-onboarding/SKILL.md): Four-phase enterprise onboarding — contract to value realization, preventing adoption cliff, Week 4 ghosting pattern
- [gtm-operating-cadence](.github/skills/gtm-operating-cadence/SKILL.md): Meeting rhythms, metric reporting, quarterly planning, decision velocity for scaling companies
- [gtm-partnership-architecture](.github/skills/gtm-partnership-architecture/SKILL.md): Build and scale partner ecosystems — partner tiers, co-marketing, build-vs-partner decisions
- [gtm-positioning-strategy](.github/skills/gtm-positioning-strategy/SKILL.md): Find and own a defensible market position — messaging differentiation, Crawl-Walk-Run rollout
- [gtm-product-led-growth](.github/skills/gtm-product-led-growth/SKILL.md): Self-serve acquisition and expansion — PLG vs sales-led decision, activation, freemium conversion
- [gtm-technical-product-pricing](.github/skills/gtm-technical-product-pricing/SKILL.md): Pricing strategy for technical products — usage-based vs seat-based, freemium thresholds, enterprise pricing

### Game Development

- [game-architecture](.github/skills/game-architecture/SKILL.md): Engine-agnostic patterns — ECS, game loop, FSM, object pooling, event bus, scene management, save/load
- [unity-game-builder](.github/skills/unity-game-builder/SKILL.md): Unity patterns — MonoBehaviour lifecycle, ScriptableObjects, Input System, Tilemap, Cinemachine 2D, ECS/DOTS, genre patterns (Metroidvania, roguelike, shmup, top-down, turn-based)
- [unreal-game-builder](.github/skills/unreal-game-builder/SKILL.md): Unreal Engine patterns — UObject hierarchy, UE macros, C++ vs Blueprint, Enhanced Input, GAS, delegates, subsystems, GC
- [godot-game-builder](.github/skills/godot-game-builder/SKILL.md): Godot 4.x patterns — GDScript, Node/Scene system, signals, CharacterBody2D/3D, AnimationTree, custom Resources, export
- [gamemaker-game-builder](.github/skills/gamemaker-game-builder/SKILL.md): GameMaker Studio 2 / GML patterns — Object/Event lifecycle, collision, Alarm timers, ds_list/ds_map, room management, export checklist
- [phaser-game-builder](.github/skills/phaser-game-builder/SKILL.md): Phaser 3 TypeScript patterns — Scene lifecycle, texture atlases, Arcade Physics, Tiled tilemaps, Scene transitions, object pooling
- [love2d-game-builder](.github/skills/love2d-game-builder/SKILL.md): LÖVE 11.x Lua patterns — conf.lua setup, scene manager, spritesheet quads, AABB collision, physics, audio, SpriteBatch
- [game-design-patterns](.github/skills/game-design-patterns/SKILL.md): Engine-agnostic game design — core loop, meta loop, game feel, reward systems, difficulty curves, feedback loops, onboarding
- [game-narrative](.github/skills/game-narrative/SKILL.md): Narrative design — branching dialogue, quest structure, character arcs, world-building, ludonarrative harmony
- [game-theory](.github/skills/game-theory/SKILL.md): Formal game theory and player psychology — Nash equilibria, incentive structures, economy design, PvP balance
- [game-level-design](.github/skills/game-level-design/SKILL.md): Level design — layout, player flow, encounter spaces, pacing, set-pieces, environmental storytelling
- [game-audio](.github/skills/game-audio/SKILL.md): Game audio — adaptive music, spatial audio, SFX, bark systems, FMOD/Wwise, audio pooling, mix priorities
- [game-ui-ux](.github/skills/game-ui-ux/SKILL.md): Game UI/UX — HUD design, menus, diegetic UI, accessibility, controller navigation, inventory interfaces

### Mobile

- [ios-app-builder](.github/skills/ios-app-builder/SKILL.md): iOS/iPadOS patterns — SwiftUI, NavigationSplitView, adaptive layouts, Core Data, Keychain, StoreKit 2, App Store submission
- [android-app-builder](.github/skills/android-app-builder/SKILL.md): Android patterns — Jetpack Compose, ViewModel, WindowSizeClass, Room, WorkManager, Play Billing, Play Store submission
- [mobile-app-architecture](.github/skills/mobile-app-architecture/SKILL.md): Cross-platform mobile architecture — MVVM, offline-first, adaptive navigation (phone vs tablet), deep linking, push notifications

### React Migration

- [react-audit-grep-patterns](.github/skills/react-audit-grep-patterns/SKILL.md): Complete grep scan library for auditing React codebases before a React 18 or 19 upgrade
- [react18-batching-patterns](.github/skills/react18-batching-patterns/SKILL.md): Diagnose and fix automatic batching regressions in React 18 class components
- [react18-dep-compatibility](.github/skills/react18-dep-compatibility/SKILL.md): React 18.3.1 and React 19 dependency compatibility matrix
- [react18-enzyme-to-rtl](.github/skills/react18-enzyme-to-rtl/SKILL.md): Enzyme → React Testing Library migration patterns for React 18
- [react18-legacy-context](.github/skills/react18-legacy-context/SKILL.md): Migrate legacy context API (contextTypes / childContextTypes) to createContext
- [react18-lifecycle-patterns](.github/skills/react18-lifecycle-patterns/SKILL.md): Migrate unsafe lifecycle methods (componentWillMount, componentWillReceiveProps, componentWillUpdate)
- [react18-string-refs](.github/skills/react18-string-refs/SKILL.md): Migrate string refs to React.createRef() in class components
- [react19-concurrent-patterns](.github/skills/react19-concurrent-patterns/SKILL.md): Adopt React 19 APIs — useTransition, useDeferredValue, Suspense, use(), useOptimistic, Actions
- [react19-source-patterns](.github/skills/react19-source-patterns/SKILL.md): React 19 source-file migration — API changes, ref handling, context updates
- [react19-test-patterns](.github/skills/react19-test-patterns/SKILL.md): Migrate test files to React 19 — act() imports, Simulate removal, StrictMode call count changes

### Web & Full-stack

- [web-app-builder](.github/skills/web-app-builder/SKILL.md): React/Next.js patterns — App Router, SSR/SSG/CSR, TanStack Query, Zustand, responsive layout, auth, Core Web Vitals
- [fullstack-cross-platform](.github/skills/fullstack-cross-platform/SKILL.md): Keeping web, Android, and iOS in sync — shared OpenAPI contract, design tokens, feature flags, API versioning, release coordination
